pr_title: ESQL: Make esql version required in REST requests
pr_body:
* Enable corresponding validation in EsqlQueryRequest.
* Add the ES|QL version to all requests to `/_query` in integration tests.

For mixed cluster tests, impersonates a language client with version 8.13, the only exception in which we do not require the version to be sent (based on https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/107497 by @nik9000 ).

Fix https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/107403
Main part of https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/104890

comments: Re-labelling as medium risk, as esql is not GA pre 8.14.

review_comments: I want to revert this before merging and create a separate PR for it, so that the actual - breaking - API change becomes a single, small PR that can be easily reverted.
Nevermind, discussed with @nik9000 : we can still revert just this in case something goes wrong.
We're going to keep this in to save the few hours of build time. If something goes wrong we can back out just this line if we have to.

Refactored `x-pack/plugin/esql/qa/server/single-node/src/yamlRestTest/java/org/elasticsearch/xpack/esql/qa/single_node/EsqlClientYamlAsyncIT.java` a little bit, but failed moving this into a place to be used by multiple yaml tests from :/
Needs reverting as well before this gets merged.
We're going to keep this one and just enable the validation.
